result.rationale: The diff shows TopicEmbed.import (app/models/topic_embed.rb line 11) does `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` with no logging or error signal, and PollFeed also has a fallback (`url = i.id if url.blank? || url !~ ...`) suggesting some feed items are expected to fall through. Imported entries whose link/id is not a valid http URL are silently dropped, making partial feed import failures invisible to operators. This is a genuine, specific observability concern grounded in the new code, though arguably intentional validation rather than incorrect behavior.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the first line is `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which will silently return `nil` for non-http(s) URLs with no logging or error reporting. Since callers like `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` iterate items and call `TopicEmbed.import(...)` without checking/logging the return value, some feed entries could be skipped without any visibility. This is an observability/diagnostics concern grounded in the diff, not a strictly verifiable correctness defect given no stated requirement to import non-http(s) links or to log skips.
